off_game.note: Leaves the game -- targeting a person rather than a player. Weighted hardest, and the lowest bar for a chat deny. DIRECTED FORMS ONLY: 'dox you', never bare 'doxxing'. The word is discussable and the act is not, and the bare noun proved it -- the top five accounts by score in the 2025 dump were an ad fleet whose copy contained it.

slur.note: Counted, never scored. Context is not visible to a keyword list, so a reviewer reads the lines.

scam.note: Kit-relevant in its own right: someone running stash scams is a different question from someone swearing.

profanity.note: Present so the count is VISIBLE, not so it counts against anyone. 2b2t's ambient register -- expect a high base rate that means nothing.

_readme: Copy to lexicon.json (gitignored) and point screening.lexicon_path at it.
The slur and profanity lists ship EMPTY on purpose. A public repository is the wrong
place for them, and yours should come from mining your own corpus rather than from
Put the NORMALISED form in 'terms'. One entry covers its whole spelling family: the
normaliser folds case, accents, separators, repeated characters and digit/symbol
Mind the length floor. A term whose NORMALISED form is under 6 characters only ever
matches a whole token -- it will not fire inside a longer word, and it will not be
caught when spelled out with separators. That is deliberate: measured against the
2025 dump, relaxing it flagged 26% of all chat.
